basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old IT professional living in Sydney, Australia. I've been on Reddit for nearly a decade, and I enjoy discussing anime, especially the 'Attack on Titan' series. I'm a big fan of Eren and Mikasa's relationship, which explains my frequent visits to the Eremika subreddit. When I'm not working or watching anime, I keep up with the latest trends in cryptocurrency, particularly SafeMoon. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings in the local gym or catching up with mates over a few beers. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have worked in various tech roles over the years. I'm self-taught in blockchain technology and actively participate in discussions about emerging cryptocurrencies. My passion for anime started in university, and I've since become quite knowledgeable about different series and their fandoms.
